patch_description: Crossover of the two best-performing programs. From the pipeline version we keep the adaptive-R forward Kalman with robust gating, the RTS smoother, the slope-lead compensation (which gave it the best slope_changes=48.4 and false_reversals=34.6), and the light third SG polish. From the volatility-adaptive version we import the multi-scale zero-phase SG blend with Gaussian volatility-gated soft weights (which gave it the best lag_error=0.27, correlation=0.97, noise_reduction=0.82), but with gentler base half-width (window_size//4) so the pipeline's smoothness advantage is not lost. The combined pipeline: volatility schedule → Kalman → RTS → volatility-gated multi-scale SG blend → slope-lead compensation → light zero-phase SG polish → end-aligned trim. This targets simultaneously responsiveness (small scales in quiet regions), noise suppression (large scales in volatile regions), and reversal suppression (lead compensation + polish), while keeping the identical API (adaptive_filter, enhanced_filter_with_trend_preservation, process_signal) and output contract (length = n - window_size + 1).
